newsitem.title: USA: Pa. Susquehanna 1 nuclear unit at 74 pct power.
newsitem.headline: Pa. Susquehanna 1 nuclear unit at 74 pct power.

text.p: The 1,090 megawatt (MW) Susquehanna 1 nuclear unit was operating at 74 percent power Wednesday morning after exiting a maintenance outage late Monday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
Full power will likely be achieved sometime Thursday, the company reported earlier this week.
The unit, in Berwick, Pa., was shut Feb 25 in anticipation of a loss of vacuum in its main condenser.
The adjacent unit 2, with a generating capacity of 1,094 MW, was still off line for a refueling outage, scheduled to end around April 12.

Both units are jointly owned by Pennsylvania Power and Light Co and Allegheny Electric Cooperative. They account for 30 percent of PP&L's power deliveries and 20 percent of its installed generation capacity.
